title: committed-fixture
responsibility: Publish metadata for synthetic fixture commits while preserving normal resource admission.

inputs.name: fixtureGit.root
inputs.description: Disposable Git project in which to execute the fixture command.

inputs.name: fixtureGit.args
inputs.description: Git arguments authored by the fixture; commit commands also publish metadata.

inputs.name: publishFixture.root
inputs.description: Disposable project whose exact revision is being validated.

inputs.name: publishFixture.commit
inputs.description: Source commit or revision to validate; defaults to HEAD.

inputs.name: seedOwnedFixture.root
inputs.description: Disposable project receiving the opaque source ownership declaration.

inputs.name: seedOwnedFixture.source
inputs.description: Owned source path; defaults to src/owned.ts.

outputs.name: fixtureGit
outputs.description: Trimmed Git output after publishing any new commit metadata.

outputs.name: publishFixture
outputs.description: Persist the real validation report, including intentional invalid fixture diagnostics.

outputs.name: seedOwnedFixture
outputs.description: Write the fixture source ownership and empty callable contract.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Refuse Git or producer execution failures and uncommitted metadata reports.
